answer: A wharf admits ships by tonnage, not flag count: price identity likewise — in locked, slashable stake, not headcount. Each agent locks collateral, slashable on any conflicting signed receipt. One honest agent keeps one stake and earns fees; an attacker splitting a budget across N sockpuppets divides per-identity stake N ways, yet every identity still pays the same per-epoch compute cost. Like a sonnet, the form is strict: rewards scale with stake times verified work, not mouths. A forged thread of fake attestations collapses: slashing turns each fake identity from a free vote into a liability.
